First signature

The day we put it on paper

A bouquet, a banner, and two names side by side at the Mapusa registrar. It felt small and enormous at once.

In Goa, a civil marriage takes two signatures. The first says we intend to marry. The second says we did.

In between

Matching orange, a blue wall, and no plans to stop

The wait between signatures has been sunny streets, coordinated outfits and a lot of laughing at each other.

One more signature, and this is forever on record.
